virals_narrative: Codie Sanchez dominated the weekend with contrarian one-liners ("You get richer by acting poorer" at 285K) and a seasonal-business story about Christmas lights. Tony Dinh and Arvid Kahl cleared 5K with launch and AI posts; Square and Pat Walls were quiet. In the niche, an artist alley shopper complaint passed 8.8K views. Competitors: HipopMarkets and BoothKeeper posted nothing; new competitor BuildersBenchRe posted 2 (4 and 15 views), and two other new vendor-tool accounts (Boothloom via @newonpolsia, @MakersToolkitHQ) appeared.
